title: Sriman Narayana is the first Acharya
body:
Sriman Narayana is the first Acharya

There are many reasons why the Lord is attributed to our first Acharya. The following can be considered the most significant reasons:
a) The Lord taught the Vedas to Lord Brahma.
b) The Lord revealed the Dwaya Mantram to a scared Mahalakshmi when Madhu-Kaithaba stole the Vedas.
c) Through the teachings propagated to Lord Brahma, He made sure that man reaps the benefit of the Vedas.
d) The Lord graced the four sons of Lord Brahma- Sanatkumara, Sanaka, Sananda, and Sanatsujata, and through them, He propagated Hita.
e) He is present as the Antharyami (the one who governs from inside) of great souls like Devarishi Narada, Parasara, and Parankusha.
f) The Lord incarnated as Hamsa, Hayagriva, Nara-Narayana, Sri Krishna, and propagated Tattva-Hita-Purushartha.
g) He made a great soul, such as Bhishma, give the world great teachings such as the Neeti Shastra.
h) At the end of Dwapara Yugam, when the teachings of the Pancharatra Agamas were lost, the Lord reincarnated as Sankarshana to re-establish them.
i) To establish the Acharya-Sishya relationship, He incarnated as Nara-Narayana and taught Nara the Tirumantram to Nara at Badrinath.
j) As access to the Vedas became restricted, the Lord, through the Azhwars, gave the world the Nalayira Divya Prabandhangal or the Tamil Veda, which propagated the message of the Vedas in a local language.
k) When the Buddhists tried to preach their teachings, which went against the Vedas, the Lord, through Acharya’s teachings, re-established the Vedantic Philosophy.
